purpose: Tall rounded card: top row (label + 3-digit zero-padded index), double-circle icon, then a ruled label with arrow and a very large thin value at the bottom.

cite.quote: export function KeyCard({ label, number, title, value })

motion.sequence: own trigger at 0.3: top row fades, header fades (delay 300ms), value splits (delay 500ms, stagger 0.05)
